name: Scaled Acuity
look: an Uxie whose golden helmet is a great coiled shell of scales with a crest of red and gold scales, closed eyes, a red gem horn, teal spotted shoulder fins and two tails ending in red-gemmed lobes
entry: A Pokémon resembling Uxie, described in a scholar's notes about a being of coiled scales that slept beneath a frozen lake. Its eyes never open, yet it knows everything that happens around it.
how: Wild: very rare at night by frozen rivers, among ice spikes and on frozen peaks.
